column1: # SpiritVale status effects, 156 entries, from the community client datamine at
# Columns: id, then a pipe-separated record of
#   name | element | effect lines... | "Max stacks: N" | the skills that apply it
# Three shapes worth knowing before reading:
#   - A damage-over-time states its own per-tick formula, and they nearly all
#     share one: (Level + STR + AGI + INT) / 10, the engine's status coefficient.
#     Burning adds 3% of max health on top; Rage is 0.1% of max health per stack.
#   - A status is expressed as STATS from the StatType catalog, not as bespoke
#     code: Stun is "Cannot act; Cannot dodge; Cannot block", Blind is
#   - "Exposure" statuses are elemental-resist debuffs (-4%/lv), and a skill of
#     one element applies the exposure of ANOTHER, which is the party-play hook.
# A trailing "-" in the applied-by position means no skill applies it: it comes
# from gear, a grimoire, or a monster.
